Definition: Chizkijah, a king of Judah, also the name of two other Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hezekiah is the king of Judah who restored the worship of the Lord and prayed his way through invasion and sickness. He begins to reign at twenty-five and does what is right in the sight of the Lord, he opens the doors of the temple and keeps the Passover, and when Sennacherib's letter comes he spreads it before the Lord and prays.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hezekiah is the king I would hold up to any leader, because he took his trouble to God before he took it to any man. I hold that his prayer over the letter is the pattern for every crisis: spread it out before the Lord and leave it there.
RelatedEvents: Hezekiah and Sennacherib's Invasion; Hezekiah Restores Worship and Keeps Passover
